mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.tenant_id,r.kb_id,r.status,r.capability_version_id FROM nw_knowledge_base_revisions r JOIN nw_knowledge_bases b ON b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND b.id=r.kb_id AND b.active_revision_id=r.id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.status='active' AND r.status='published' AND b.id>0 AND r.id>0 AND r.capability_version_id IN #{versionId}

SELECT id, tenant_id, name, description, status, active_revision_id, rebuild_job_id, control_revision, embedding_model_config_id, embedding_model_revision, embedding_dimensions, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, indexing_mode, retrieval_mode, top_k, score_threshold_enabled, score_threshold, vector_weight, rerank_enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM nw_knowledge_bases WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{kbId} FOR UPDATE
